beat: systems / entry gate / version differences (Scout C)
game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Nintendo Switch 2 remake)
caveat: Zelda Wiki (zeldawiki.wiki), Nintendo.com, nintendolife.com and gematsu.com returned 403/404 to fetch, so remake facts rest on guide/review sites (KeenGamer, FinalBoss.io, NintendoEverything, Bonus Action, RPGSite, VGC). Several search hits came from junk domains (notices.mce.ca.gov, berkeleyhistoricalsociety.org) and were ignored.

findings.name: No system-level achievements on Switch 2
findings.detail: Nintendo (Bill Trinen) confirmed at Switch 2 launch window that the console has no achievement/trophy system. No source found saying this changed. Remake is Switch 2 exclusive (no other platform list exists).

findings.name: ZELDA NOTES (Nintendo Switch App) for Ocarina of Time
findings.detail: Day-one patch Version 1.1.1 (about 343 MB, Nov 4) enabled ZELDA NOTES. Off by default; toggle in game Options (right under amiibo connection) or from title screen. Needs Nintendo Switch App on phone, same Nintendo Account, game online. One source counts 11 OoT features; names seen: Map, Gossip Quests, Photo Studio, My Play Data, Global Play Data, Hall of Fallen Foes, Threads of Time, Play Ocarina, Ocarina of Time Quiz (2,000+ questions), Amiibo. Remaining features unnamed.
findings.trackable: Phone-app only, not on the Switch 2 itself. Map shows live completion percentage (only explored areas shown). NintendoEverything: Zelda Notes lets you check '100 percent completion status' from phone to find missed items.

findings.name: My Play Data (Zelda Notes) and Medals
findings.detail: Tracks in-game actions such as cutting grass or breaking pots. Bonus Action says the app has 'medals and achievements for stat milestones' and stat comparisons. In BotW/TotK, medals have four tiers (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Master). OoT medal list/count NOT found.
findings.trackable: Phone app only. Medal list for OoT unknown.

findings.name: Today's Record (Zelda Notes)
findings.detail: Daily log of accomplishments with stats such as enemies defeated. Only one weak snippet and KeenGamer mention it; not on the Bonus Action feature list.

findings.name: Gossip Quests (Zelda Notes)
findings.detail: Phone mini-quests: hint images point to in-game locations/NPCs, perform actions for points; points trade for soundtrack/ocarina music scores. Must open app near the object to record progress; needs Switch 2 and phone nearby.

findings.name: Threads of Time
findings.detail: Pause-menu story tracker: illustrated tapestry, recap per completed chapter, shows current objective. Does NOT track optional items like Heart Pieces (FinalBoss). One source (GamesRadar-type snippet) described it as covering main and optional challenges 'in more detail'; conflicts with FinalBoss.
findings.trackable: Yes, in game pause menu (story only).

findings.name: Hall of Fallen Foes
findings.detail: Replaces/stands in for 3DS Boss Challenge. Enter by choosing 'Go to sleep' in a green-glowing bed. KeenGamer unlock: clear Forest Temple as adult, return Master Sword to become child, talk to Kaepora Gaebora near Kakariko, then sleep in a green-glowing bed (e.g. Kakariko Grand Lodge). FinalBoss says a bed on Lake Hylia shore works (conflicting bed locations; unlock timing only from KeenGamer). Small statues log every defeated enemy type (description, locations, useful items); large statues = boss rematches with a timer; best time kept as Rematch Time on the statue. Trials: Spiritual Stones (Stone Statue: Queen Gohma, King Dodongo, Barinade); Five Sages (Silver Statue: Phantom Ganon, Volvagia, Morpha, Bongo Bongo, Twinrova); Hero of Time (Gold Statue: all prior plus Ganondorf and Ganon; requires finishing story). Clearing a trial adds a trophy to Link's bedroom in Kokiri Forest. Rewards cosmetic only; health carries over between fights in a trial; items restored on leaving. FinalBoss states no timer/records system is mentioned in its guide, which conflicts with KeenGamer.
findings.trackable: Yes, in-game: enemy statue collection, per-boss Rematch Time, trial trophies in bedroom. Also a Zelda Notes tile.

findings.name: Gold Skulltulas: 100 total (56 overworld, 44 dungeon)
findings.detail: Per area: Kokiri Forest+Lost Woods 7; Hyrule Field+Castle 10; Kakariko+Death Mountain 16; Zora Region 8; Lake Hylia 5; Gerudo+Desert 10; first three dungeons (Deku Tree, Dodongo's Cavern, Jabu-Jabu) 13; later dungeons incl. Ice Cavern and Bottom of the Well 31. Five tokens changed vs N64: Zora's River, Lake Hylia (no longer night-only), Lon Lon Ranch (4 to 3) with Hyrule Field gaining one and the SE marsh grotto needing two visits, Water Temple, Deku Tree. House of Skulltula rewards per KeenGamer: 10 = Adult's Wallet; 20 = Echo Gem (replaces Stone of Agony); 30 = Giant's Wallet; 40 = 20 Bombchus; 50 = Piece of Heart; 100 = Gold Rupee (200 Rupees, repeatable). Some tokens age or time-of-day gated; none labeled permanently missable by KeenGamer. Total of 100 is consistent between KeenGamer and FinalBoss, but the 56/44 split and per-area numbers are a single source.
findings.trackable: KeenGamer: the map screen shows tokens found per area (not a single total). Not independently confirmed; the in-game token counter on the pause screen was not verified.

findings.name: Heart Pieces: 36; hearts max 20
findings.detail: FinalBoss: 3 starting hearts + 8 boss Heart Containers + 9 containers from 36 Heart Pieces = 20. Same as N64 math. Single source; not verified vs a remake item list.
findings.trackable: Unconfirmed whether remake shows a heart-piece counter beyond the pause-screen quarter-heart indicator.

findings.name: Other FinalBoss checklist counts
findings.detail: 5 bottle slots; 12 songs (6 general, 6 warp); 6 Great Fairy rewards; 10 Magic Beans; 10 Big Poes (5 for final bottle, all 10 for 200-Rupee Gold Rupee as stated by FinalBoss). Biggoron trading sequence yields unbreakable Biggoron's Sword. Page says it does not mention any in-game completion percentage or tracker.

findings.name: Fishing Pond (Lake Hylia)
findings.detail: Child: Piece of Heart; adult: Golden Scale; Hylian Loach reported catchable in remake. Thresholds conflict: FinalBoss ~10 lb child / 13 lb adult; French guide says remake needs 50 cm or more (vs 10 lb original). Sinking Lure does not count for prizes. Fish size has randomness.
findings.trackable: No fishing record confirmed for remake (the original had one on the pond owner dialog).

findings.name: Master Quest not included at launch
findings.detail: Nintendo Everything: no Master Quest from the start or after beating the game; reviewer says remake 'isn't any more challenging than the original' and some puzzles simplified. 'Evidence' of Master Quest uncovered in files (dataminers), nothing announced. KeenGamer: no Hero Mode announced. Mirror mode not found in any remake source. No New Game Plus (Portuguese source).

findings.name: Post-game save behavior
findings.detail: After credits, Continue loads the last manual save (before the final door/Ganon's Castle sequence); no post-clear save state, same as N64. Single Portuguese source (could not fetch) plus GameWith (original-game page). Remake-specific behavior unverified.
findings.trackable: Unknown whether a cleared-file marker shows.

findings.name: Display modes and controls
findings.detail: Display modes: Standard (default), Pro (a little extra info), Master (hides all on-screen info). Targeting Hold/Toggle on ZL. Optional motion aiming, subtitles. Manual jump, sprint on roll button, free camera, horizontal item bar, real-time day/night indoors, full voice acting. Navi hints are pop-up. Microphone: hum or sing songs into Switch 2 mic; buttons still work for all songs; separate $49.99 ocarina accessory exists. Fairy thoughts feature. Conversation Log can be reread.

findings.name: amiibo
findings.detail: Young Link and Young Zelda amiibo unlock retro-themed masks (effect possibly cosmetic). Other amiibo not confirmed.

versionNotes.note: Remake is Switch 2 exclusive; no other platform listed. Developed by Nintendo EPD Production Group No. 3.
3DS Boss Challenge appears replaced by Hall of Fallen Foes (statue-based rematches with timer). Master Quest (present on 3DS) is absent at launch.
Gold Skulltula reward at 20 tokens is reportedly an 'Echo Gem' replacing the Stone of Agony; five token locations moved/changed (Lon Lon Ranch 4 to 3).
Fishing weight thresholds changed to length (50 cm) per one French guide; unconfirmed.
A player.one article claims the remake 'removed secret content'; could not be fetched, contents unknown. Another source says many original secrets remain.
Hero Mode, mirror mode: no remake source found; treat as absent/unconfirmed.

gaps: Could not fetch Zelda Wiki Switch 2 page, Nintendo official page, Nintendo Life, Gematsu: no official first-party confirmation of features.
Whether the game itself shows a numeric heart-piece or Gold Skulltula total on the pause screen: not confirmed (only KeenGamer's per-area map claim).
Whether the game has an in-game completion percentage: only the Zelda Notes Map claims it; in-game display unconfirmed.
Whether Zelda Notes in OoT has medals, how many, and what conditions: unconfirmed. Whether Today's Record is real: only weak sources.

Whether the Zelda Notes app has its own 'achievements': Bonus Action says 'medals and achievements', and a 2025 VGC report mentions in-app achievement lists on Switch 2 Edition games; neither confirmed for OoT. This would NOT be a system-level list.
Hall of Fallen Foes unlock condition and bed locations conflict between sources; timer/records conflict.

Missable content: no remake-specific list found. Original N64 missables (Gold Skulltulas that required timing, e.g. kid-only/adult-only, Kakariko windmill/other) NOT verified for remake. Big Poe 10 count and Biggoron sequence timings not verified.
Fishing remake thresholds and whether fishing record is displayed unverified.
Quest Status pause screen details (does it show counts, e.g. Gold Skulltula count) not verified.
GameChat, Nintendo Switch Online, multiplayer features: nothing found; likely none.
Master Quest DLC rumor: only 'datamined' claim, unconfirmed.
Save slot count and cleared-file marker unverified.
